//: The workspace's shared configuration, finished by SPA-180: `tsconfig.base.json` (mono-1), the eslint base (`eslint.base.js`, with the architecture zones) and the `instrument/vocabulary` rule beside it in `eslint-rules/`, and the prettier config (`prettier.base.js`). Neither carries the name its tool auto-discovers, on purpose: an `eslint.config.js` here would be the config ESLint found first when linting this package, with every root-relative glob re-based to this directory (found by SPA-180 — it broke `@spaces/config#lint` on the first run). Every package extends the tsconfig by path; eslint and prettier are reached through the two root shims (`eslint.config.js`, `prettier.config.js` at the repo root re-export `./eslint` and `./prettier`), because both tools look a config up from the cwd and a copy inside a package would re-base the root-relative zone globs. `fixtures/` holds the two directories the sdk and plugin zones are fenced against until `packages/sdk` (sdk-3) and `plugins/*` exist; each holds one empty module and nothing else.
name: @spaces/config
//devDependencies: What the eslint base and the prettier config import, plus the tools themselves. They resolve from this directory, so they are this package's and no longer the root's; eslint, prettier and typescript stay the root's too, because the binaries run from there (lefthook, CI, `pnpm exec`). All of it is devDependencies and none of it dependencies (SPA-183): this package is configuration, read only at development time, and a `pnpm install --prod` installs every workspace importer's dependencies — so the plugins listed as dependencies put eslint, typescript-eslint and typescript into the image's runtime node_modules, which runs none of them. A devDependency of a private workspace package is still installed and linked here in every developer and CI checkout.
